result.summary: The landlord was asked on 22 Feb (event 004) about two jobs: a blocked toilet and a bedroom window that won't close. They haven't replied, and there is no approval on record. The tenant has since said the toilet is fixed (event 006). I sent the landlord a formal approval request covering only the window inspection and repair or quote (approval 44). I updated the tenant and asked whether the window can still be secured. The case is on hold for 2 days while we wait for the landlord.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord was asked in event 004 whether we could send a contractor, but no reply is visible and no approval or spend limit is recorded, so I can't assign a contractor yet. The tenant's reply (event 006, classified 'confirms_fixed', autonomy 'auto') reduces the job to the window only, so the landlord needed an updated, clear request. The window has a moderate safety-risk score (0.61). If it can't be secured, that would make it urgent or an emergency, so I asked the tenant directly.

alternatives_considered.why_not: There is no landlord approval or pre-approved limit on record, and the job isn't an emergency based on current information.
This is a routine window repair with no conflict, complaint or confirmed safety issue. The next step belongs to the landlord.
The landlord's request still mentioned the toilet, and no approval was tracked in the CRM, so there was nothing to follow up on.
